target.name: audit_problems
target.content: def audit_problems(events, port):     problems = []     for event in events:         if event["event"] == "socket.connect":             address = event["address"]             if not (isinstance(address, list) and address[:2] == ["127.0.0.1", port]):                 problems.append(f"E_SERVICE: connection to {address} (only the loopback fixture is allowed)")         elif event["event"] == "import" and event["module"] in FORBIDDEN_MODULES:             problems.append(f"E_SERVICE: imported service/model module {event['module']}")     if not any(event["event"] == "import" for event in events):         problems.append("E_SERVICE: audit hook recorded nothing; isolation is unproven")     return problems
